aliases: Deep Atomic INL Nuclear-Powered AI Data Center
status_detail: DOE issued an RFA for AI data centers/energy projects at Idaho National Laboratory in September 2025; Data Center Dynamics reported Deep Atomic submitted a proposal for a nuclear-powered AI data center campus at INL with MK60 60 MWe power and 60 MW integrated cooling, with initial operations targeted within 24-36 months if approved.
notes: County attribution is based on Idaho Falls/Bonneville labeling in data-center trackers and public reporting; INL land spans/abuts multiple counties, so exact parcel jurisdiction should be verified if DOE releases award/site documents.
